Earlier, WhatsApp opened up iPhone users to add an additional account within the same app, and now they are exploring expanding support to up to three accounts. Details below.

WhatsApp Will Support Up to Three Accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched its multi-account support feature on iPhone, allowing users to add an additional account within the same app.

After several months of beta testing, this feature gave users an extra option, no longer requiring them to rely on WhatsApp Business as a temporary solution for managing a second account.

Now, according to WABetaInfo's findings, the app appears to be exploring expanding the feature to let users switch between up to three accounts without needing to log out.

Below is the report from WABetaInfo:

The report adds that each account will retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo notes that while two accounts may be enough for many users, this feature will be very useful for those who have different combinations of work and personal phone numbers.

However, this feature is still in the development stage, and beta testers have not been able to use it yet, meaning it may still be some time before a wider rollout.
